title: XDMEvent
description: An Experience Data Model (XDM) event object.

identityMap.description: A map of identity namespaces to arrays of identity objects for cross-device identity stitching.

eventType.description: The type of event (e.g., web.webpagedetails.pageViews, commerce.productViews, commerce.purchases).

timestamp.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the event.
